items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: I learned from the Carolina Stumpers. Frank Flood and the guys.

ctx.x: Is there some one or two people you pick out from that that really maybe taught you how to think? Changed the way you thought?

In Carolina, the Stumpers. You’ve heard of the Cotton Pickin’ Stumpers, I know you have. The Carolina Cotton Pickin’ Stumpers. That’s a different band. I learned from the Carolina Stumpers. Frank Flood and the guys. I was 14 probably in 1953, or 13 or whatever, when these guys were already in their late twenties. And they showed me how to — what’s the word I’m looking for — how to contemplate, how to regurgitate the moment, your space, your temporal space, sorting it out. And how to really be critical of yourself…
I know what you’re talking about.
